decisions.rationale: For ordered bounds, selecting the median of low, value, and high implements inclusive clamping; the committed test passes and diff check is clean.
The candidate replaces case-insensitive sorting with case-sensitive sorting, violating the specification; the committed test fails.
Changing <= to < excludes values equal to the limit, directly violating the inclusive-boundary requirement; the boundary test fails.
The candidate reverses the required test assertion while the implementation still returns true; consequently the committed test suite fails.

strategy_update: Prioritized direct specification-to-diff comparison and used permitted tests only as corroborating evidence.
